header_statement: The open-source drop ships NO definition for these structs. The layout below is INFERRED from field usage only and is NOT verified against the real binary format.

onyx_dt.smart_charge: status okay, cell_type=1, support_cc_ichg, thresholds 800/65536 with current reduction 100/200, enable_fv_dec_by_cc=1

decision: Smart policy, DT current limits, scene and SOC controls retained. Separate BASP binary override transport returns EOPNOTSUPP on opening smart_charge_cdev because the inferred layout cannot safely set charging parameters. No guessed blob parsing or mapped heap. Obtain and verify true ABI to implement override.
